title: Student V0.1 JOB 05 — contradictory QA
purpose: Independently attack the real served/browser Student V0.1 path and expose any mismatch between seam-level integration PASS and actual learner behavior without repairing product code.
invariants: QA is independent and may add only QA fixtures/probes/evidence under its own namespace.
The exact qualified product/evidence bytes are treated as read-only.
A seam-level PASS is not accepted as proof of a real served learner journey.
QA must exercise the built application through a browser path where applicable.
Any discovered product defect is reported with exact reproduction and owner classification; QA must not repair it.
No Wave 2 sibling output is consumed.
No contract, architecture, runtime, presentation, authoring, manifest or workflow semantics are changed.
requiredEvidence: Real browser import/start path using an independently fixed valid V4 QA fixture.
All supported activity families challenged through the real application path, not only isolated presentation functions.
adversarialTests: A fixture that passes canonical V4 validation but reaches a real application unsupported-type boundary must produce HOLD, not be simplified to qcm/fill.
A browser-only failure cannot be waived because lower-level unit tests pass.
A direct projectActivityPresentation()/renderActivityPresentation composition does not substitute for served session navigation.
No test may expose scoring secrets to the presentation layer merely to make automation easier.
Any attempt to fix product source from QA scope is a scope FAIL.
nonGoals: Merging to main or starting real students.
independentReview: This job must derive its own defect hypotheses from repository state.
It must prefer false-PASS challenges over replaying only known happy paths.
A final PASS requires no unclassified contradiction between served behavior and qualified seams.
rollback: Close the JOB05 PR and delete its branch; product candidate and all sibling branches remain unchanged.
